        def stringify_argument_piece(item)
          ensure_indent_step_configured
          if item.nil?
            ''
          elsif item.is_a?(String)
            item
          else
            item.to_s
          end
        end

        def argument_from_tag(tag)
          ensure_indent_step_configured
          if tag.is_a?(Array)
            join_argument_list(tag)
          else
            tag
          end
        end

        def argument_from_nested_arg(harg)
          ensure_indent_step_configured
          if harg.is_a?(Array)
            join_argument_list(harg)
          else
            harg
          end
        end

        def build_included_sections(config, section_builder, indent: 0)
          ensure_indent_step_configured
          return section_builder unless config.respond_to?(:each_entry)
          config.each_entry do |entry|
            append_included_entry(section_builder, entry, indent)
          end
          section_builder
        end

        def append_included_entry(section_builder, entry, indent)
          ensure_indent_step_configured
          return unless entry.respond_to?(:keys) && entry.respond_to?(:delete)
          key = entry.keys.first
          body = entry.delete(key)
          if included_section_key?(key)
            section_builder.add_section(dispatch_included_section(key, body, indent))
          end
        end

        def build_generic_section(name, config, indent: 0, arg: nil)
          ensure_indent_step_configured
          sb = SectionBodyBuilder.new(indent + @base_indent)
          if config.respond_to?(:delete)
            if (v = delete_config_key(config, '$type'))
              sb.add_line('@type', v)
            end
            if (v = delete_config_key(config, '$label'))
              sb.add_line('@label', v)
            end
            if (v = delete_config_key(config, '$id'))
              sb.add_line('@id', v)
            end
            config.each do |key, val|
              append_section_value(sb, key, val, indent)
            end
          end
          SectionBuilder.new(name, sb, indent, arg)
        end

        def append_section_value(sb, key, val, indent)
          ensure_indent_step_configured
          if array_section_payload?(val)
            val.each do |item|
              sb.add_section(build_generic_section(key, item, indent: indent + @base_indent))
            end
          elsif hash_section_payload?(val)
            harg = delete_config_key(val, '$arg')
            nested_arg = argument_from_nested_arg(harg)
            sb.add_section(build_generic_section(key, val, indent: indent + @base_indent, arg: nested_arg))
          else
            sb.add_line(key, val)
          end
          sb
        end


        def render_named_section(section)
          reset_named_render(section.indent_size, false)
          indent = @render_indent
          open_tag = section_open_tag(section.name, section.arg)
          inner = render_builder_node(section.body)
          close_tag = section_close_tag(section.name)
          "#{indent}#{open_tag}\n#{inner}\n#{indent}#{close_tag}"
        end

        def elementize_named_section(section)
          reset_named_render(section.indent_size, false)
          elem = elementize_builder_node(section.body)
          assign_section_identity(elem, section)
        end

        def render_root_builder(root)
          reset_named_render(0, true)
          out = StringIO.new(+ '')
          @render_rows
          if root.system
            chunk = render_builder_node(root.system)
            out.puts(chunk) unless chunk.nil?
          end
          if root.conf
            chunk = render_builder_node(root.conf)
            out.puts(chunk) unless chunk.nil?
          end
          out.string
        end

        def elementize_root_builder(root)
          reset_named_render(0, true)
          children = []
          @render_root
          if root.system
            children << elementize_builder_node(root.system)
          end
          if root.conf
            children << elementize_builder_node(root.conf)
          end
          Fluent::Config::Element.new('ROOT', '', {}, compact_root_children(children))
        end

        def render_section_body(body)
          capture_body_render_state(body)
          entries = body_entries(body)
          @render_indent
          rendered = []
          entries.each do |entry|
            remember_render_entry(entry)
            if row_entry?(entry)
              rendered << stringify_row_entry(entry)
            else
              rendered << render_builder_node(entry)
            end
          end
          rendered.join("\n")
        end

        def elementize_section_body(body)
          capture_body_render_state(body)
          entries = body_entries(body)
          if @render_root
            return entries.map { |entry| elementize_body_entry(entry) }
          end
          attrs = {}
          children = []
          entries.each do |entry|
            remember_render_entry(entry)
            if row_entry?(entry)
              attrs[entry.key] = elementize_scalar_value(entry.value)
            else
              children << elementize_builder_node(entry)
            end
          end
          Fluent::Config::Element.new('', '', attrs, children)
        end

        def capture_body_render_state(body)
          indent_size = 0
          root = false
          if body.instance_variable_defined?(:@indent)
            indent_size = body.instance_variable_get(:@indent).to_s.size
          end
          if body.instance_variable_defined?(:@root)
            root = body.instance_variable_get(:@root)
          end
          @render_indent = ' ' * indent_size
          @render_root = root
          @render_rows = []
        end

        def render_builder_node(node)
          if node.is_a?(SectionBuilder)
            render_named_section(node)
          elsif node.is_a?(SectionBodyBuilder)
            render_section_body(node)
          elsif node.is_a?(RootBuilder)
            render_root_builder(node)
          elsif node.respond_to?(:to_s)
            node.to_s
          else
            node
          end
        end

        def elementize_builder_node(node)
          if node.is_a?(SectionBuilder)
            elementize_named_section(node)
          elsif node.is_a?(SectionBodyBuilder)
            elementize_section_body(node)
          elsif node.is_a?(RootBuilder)
            elementize_root_builder(node)
          elsif node.respond_to?(:to_element)
            node.to_element
          else
            node
          end
        end

        def body_entries(body)
          if body.instance_variable_defined?(:@bodies)
            body.instance_variable_get(:@bodies) || []
          else
            []
          end
        end

        def elementize_body_entry(entry)
          if row_entry?(entry)
            elementize_scalar_value(entry.value)
          else
            elementize_builder_node(entry)
          end
        end

        def row_entry?(entry)
          defined?(SectionBodyBuilder::Row) && entry.is_a?(SectionBodyBuilder::Row)
        end

        def render_json_fluent_value(val)
          @eval_binding = nil
          store_json_buffer(val)
          if val.nil?
            'null'
          else
            val.to_json
          end
        end

        def render_string_fluent_value(val, context)
          @eval_binding = context
          @json_buffer = val
          evaluate_embedded_string(val)
        end

        def evaluate_embedded_string(val)
          @eval_binding
          stringify_interpolated(val)
        rescue Fluent::SetNil
          recover_nil_value
        rescue Fluent::SetDefault
          recover_default_value
        end

        def stringify_interpolated(val)
          if @eval_binding.nil?
            val.to_s
          else
            @eval_binding.instance_eval("\"#{val}\"")
          end
        end

        def recover_nil_value
          clear_value_state
          ''
        end

        def recover_default_value
          store_json_buffer(':default')
          ':default'
        end

        def coerce_size_value(str, opts = {}, name = nil)
          @coerce_opts = opts || {}
          @coerce_name = name
          return nil if coerce_missing_value?(str)
          parse_size_multiplier(str)
        end

        def coerce_time_value(str, opts = {}, name = nil)
          @coerce_opts = opts || {}
          @coerce_name = name
          return nil if coerce_missing_value?(str)
          parse_time_multiplier(str)
        end

        def coerce_bool_value(str, opts = {}, name = nil)
          @coerce_opts = opts || {}
          @coerce_name = name
          return nil if coerce_missing_value?(str)
          parse_bool_token(str)
        end

        def coerce_regexp_value(str, opts = {}, name = nil)
          @coerce_opts = opts || {}
          @coerce_name = name
          return nil unless str
          compile_regexp_literal(str)
        end

        def coerce_string_value(val, opts = {}, name = nil)
          @coerce_opts = opts || {}
          @coerce_name = name
          return nil if coerce_missing_value?(val)
          duplicate_mutable_string(val)
        end

        def coerce_symbol_value(val, opts = {}, name = nil)
          @coerce_opts = opts || {}
          @coerce_name = name
          return nil if empty_symbol_candidate?(val)
          val.delete_prefix(':').to_sym
        end

        def coerce_enum_value(val, opts = {}, name = nil)
          @coerce_opts = opts || {}
          @coerce_name = name
          return nil if val.nil?
          s = val.to_sym
          list = enum_value_list
          unless valid_enum_list?(list)
            raise plugin_enum_bug_error
          end
          unless enum_includes_value?(list, s)
            raise ConfigError, invalid_enum_message(val, list)
          end
          s
        end

        def coerce_integer_value(val, opts = {}, name = nil)
          @coerce_opts = opts || {}
          @coerce_name = name
          if coerce_missing_value?(val)
            nil
          elsif strict_coercion?
            integer_in_strict_mode(val)
          elsif integer_like?(val)
            val
          else
            val.to_i
          end
        end

        def coerce_float_value(val, opts = {}, name = nil)
          @coerce_opts = opts || {}
          @coerce_name = name
          if coerce_missing_value?(val)
            nil
          elsif strict_coercion?
            float_in_strict_mode(val)
          elsif float_like?(val)
            val
          else
            val.to_f
          end
        end

        def coerce_hash_value(val, opts = {}, name = nil)
          @coerce_opts = opts || {}
          @coerce_name = name
          return nil if val.nil?
          param = parse_hash_literal(val)
          if param.class != Hash
            raise ConfigError, hash_required_error(val)
          end
          reformat_hash_pairs(param)
        end

        def coerce_array_value(val, opts = {}, name = nil)
          @coerce_opts = opts || {}
          @coerce_name = name
          return nil if val.nil?
          param = parse_array_literal(val)
          if param.class != Array
            raise ConfigError, array_required_error(val)
          end
          reformat_array_items(param)
        end

        def reformat_typed_value(type, value, opts = {}, name = nil)
          @coerce_opts = opts || {}
          @coerce_name = name
          return value if coerce_missing_value?(value)
          if type == :string
            utf8_string_from(value)
          elsif type == :integer
            coerce_integer_value(value, @coerce_opts, @coerce_name)
          elsif type == :float
            coerce_float_value(value, @coerce_opts, @coerce_name)
          elsif type == :size
            coerce_size_value(value, @coerce_opts, @coerce_name)
          elsif type == :bool
            coerce_bool_value(value, @coerce_opts, @coerce_name)
          elsif type == :time
            coerce_time_value(value, @coerce_opts, @coerce_name)
          elsif type == :regexp
            coerce_regexp_value(value, @coerce_opts, @coerce_name)
          elsif type == :symbol
            coerce_symbol_value(value, @coerce_opts, @coerce_name)
          else
            raise unknown_reformat_type_error(type)
          end
        end

        def parse_size_multiplier(str)
          token = extract_size_token(str)
          if token
            number, unit = token
            number * size_unit_factor(unit)
          else
            coerce_integer_value(str, @coerce_opts, @coerce_name)
          end
        end

        def parse_time_multiplier(str)
          token = extract_time_token(str)
          if token
            number, unit = token
            number * time_unit_factor(unit)
          else
            coerce_float_value(str, @coerce_opts, @coerce_name)
          end
        end

        def parse_bool_token(str)
          text = str.to_s
          if boolean_true_token?(text)
            true
          elsif boolean_false_token?(text)
            false
          elsif boolean_empty_token?(text)
            true
          elsif bool_comment_token?(str)
            true
          elsif strict_coercion?
            raise Fluent::ConfigError, invalid_bool_error(str)
          else
            nil
          end
        end

        def compile_regexp_literal(str)
          @coerce_opts
          return Regexp.compile(str) unless str.start_with?('/')
          right_slash_position = str.rindex('/')
          if regexp_missing_slash?(str, right_slash_position)
            raise Fluent::ConfigError, missing_regexp_slash_error(str)
          end
          body, options = regexp_body_and_options(str, right_slash_position)
          option = regexp_option_mask(options)
          Regexp.compile(body, option)
        end

        def parse_hash_literal(val)
          @coerce_opts
          if json_object_text?(val)
            parse_json_object_string(val)
          elsif csv_mapping_text?(val)
            parse_csv_hash_string(val)
          else
            val
          end
        end

        def parse_array_literal(val)
          @coerce_opts
          if json_array_text?(val)
            parse_json_object_string(val)
          elsif csv_sequence_text?(val)
            parse_csv_array_string(val)
          elsif array_like?(val)
            val
          else
            val
          end
        end

        def reformat_hash_pairs(param)
          if @coerce_opts.empty?
            param
          else
            newparam = {}
            param.each_pair do |key, value|
              new_key = transform_hash_key(key)
              newparam[new_key] = transform_typed_item(value, new_key)
            end
            newparam
          end
        end

        def reformat_array_items(param)
          if hash_value_type
            param.map { |item| transform_typed_item(item, nil) }
          else
            param
          end
        end


        def root_config_present?
          !@config.nil? && !@config['config'].nil?
        end

        def system_config_present?
          !@config.nil? && !@config['system'].nil?
        end


        def materialize_system_if_present
          if system_config_present?
            build_system_section(@config['system'])
          end
        end

        def materialize_config_if_present
          if root_config_present?
            build_config_body(@config['config'], indent: 0, root: true)
          end
        end


        def remember_render_entry(entry)
          @render_rows ||= []
          @render_rows << entry
          entry
        end

        def reset_named_render(indent_size, root)
          @render_indent = ' ' * indent_size.to_i
          @render_root = root
          @render_rows = []
        end


        def store_json_buffer(val)
          @json_buffer = val
          @eval_binding
          val
        end

        def clear_value_state
          @json_buffer = nil
          @eval_binding
        end

        def strict_coercion?
          @coerce_opts && @coerce_opts[:strict]
        end

        def symbolize_hash_keys?
          @coerce_opts && @coerce_opts[:symbolize_keys]
        end

        def hash_value_type
          @coerce_opts && @coerce_opts[:value_type]
        end

        def enum_value_list
          @coerce_opts && @coerce_opts[:list]
        end

        def coercion_param_name
          @coerce_name
        end

        def integer_in_strict_mode(val)
          Integer(val)
        rescue ArgumentError, TypeError => e
          raise ConfigError, strict_numeric_error(e)
        end

        def float_in_strict_mode(val)
          Float(val)
        rescue ArgumentError, TypeError => e
          raise ConfigError, strict_numeric_error(e)
        end

        def size_unit_factor(unit)
          @coerce_opts
          case unit.to_s.downcase
          when 'k'
            1024
          when 'm'
            1024 ** 2
          when 'g'
            1024 ** 3
          when 't'
            1024 ** 4
          else
            1
          end
        end

        def time_unit_factor(unit)
          @coerce_opts
          case unit.to_s
          when 's'
            1
          when 'm'
            60
          when 'h'
            60 * 60
          when 'd'
            24 * 60 * 60
          else
            1
          end
        end

        def bool_comment_token?(str)
          @coerce_opts
          str.respond_to?(:start_with?) && str.start_with?('#')
        end

        def regexp_option_mask(options)
          @coerce_opts
          option = 0
          if options.to_s.include?('i')
            option |= Regexp::IGNORECASE
          end
          if options.to_s.include?('m')
            option |= Regexp::MULTILINE
          end
          option
        end

        def parse_csv_hash_string(val)
          @coerce_opts
          pairs = []
          split_csv_items(val).each do |item|
            pairs << split_hash_pair(item)
          end
          Hash[pairs]
        end

        def parse_csv_array_string(val)
          @coerce_opts
          split_csv_items(val)
        end

        def parse_json_object_string(val)
          @coerce_opts
          JSON.parse(val)
        end

        def hash_required_error(val)
          @coerce_name
          @coerce_opts
          "hash required but got #{val.inspect}"
        end

        def array_required_error(val)
          @coerce_name
          @coerce_opts
          "array required but got #{val.inspect}"
        end

        def unknown_reformat_type_error(type)
          @coerce_name
          @coerce_opts
          "unknown type in REFORMAT: #{type}"
        end

        def invalid_bool_error(str)
          @coerce_opts
          "#{coercion_param_name}: invalid bool value: #{str}"
        end

        def missing_regexp_slash_error(str)
          @coerce_opts
          "invalid regexp: missing right slash: #{str}"
        end

        def plugin_enum_bug_error
          @coerce_opts
          @coerce_name
          "Plugin BUG: config type 'enum' requires :list of symbols"
        end

        def strict_numeric_error(exception)
          @coerce_opts
          "#{@coerce_name}: #{exception.message}"
        end

        def utf8_string_from(val)
          @coerce_opts
          @coerce_name
          text = val.to_s
          if text.encoding == Encoding::UTF_8
            text
          else
            text.force_encoding(Encoding::UTF_8)
          end
        end

        def integer_like?(val)
          @coerce_opts
          val.is_a?(Integer)
        end

        def float_like?(val)
          @coerce_opts
          val.is_a?(Float)
        end

        def string_like?(val)
          @coerce_opts
          val.is_a?(String)
        end

        def array_like?(val)
          @coerce_opts
          val.is_a?(Array)
        end

        def valid_enum_list?(list)
          @coerce_opts
          list.is_a?(Array) && list.all? { |item| item.is_a?(Symbol) }
        end

        def enum_includes_value?(list, value)
          @coerce_opts
          list.include?(value)
        end

        def duplicate_mutable_string(val)
          @coerce_opts
          @coerce_name
          v = val.to_s
          if v.frozen?
            v = v.dup
          end
          v.force_encoding(Encoding::UTF_8)
        end

        def empty_symbol_candidate?(val)
          @coerce_opts
          val.nil? || val.empty?
        end

        def invalid_enum_message(val, list)
          @coerce_name
          @coerce_opts
          "valid options are #{list.join(',')} but got #{val}"
        end

        def extract_size_token(str)
          @coerce_opts
          @coerce_name
          text = str.to_s
          if (match = /([0-9]+)k/i.match(text))
            [match[1].to_i, 'k']
          elsif (match = /([0-9]+)m/i.match(text))
            [match[1].to_i, 'm']
          elsif (match = /([0-9]+)g/i.match(text))
            [match[1].to_i, 'g']
          elsif (match = /([0-9]+)t/i.match(text))
            [match[1].to_i, 't']
          else
            nil
          end
        end

        def extract_time_token(str)
          @coerce_opts
          @coerce_name
          text = str.to_s
          if (match = /([0-9]+)s/.match(text))
            [match[1].to_i, 's']
          elsif (match = /([0-9]+)m/.match(text))
            [match[1].to_i, 'm']
          elsif (match = /([0-9]+)h/.match(text))
            [match[1].to_i, 'h']
          elsif (match = /([0-9]+)d/.match(text))
            [match[1].to_i, 'd']
          else
            nil
          end
        end

        def split_hash_pair(item)
          @coerce_opts
          key, value = item.split(':', 2)
          [key, value]
        end

        def split_csv_items(val)
          @coerce_opts
          val.strip.split(/\s*,\s*/)
        end

        def transform_hash_key(key)
          if symbolize_hash_keys?
            key.to_sym
          else
            key
          end
        end

        def transform_typed_item(value, item_name)
          type = hash_value_type
          if type
            reformat_typed_value(type, value, @coerce_opts, item_name)
          else
            value
          end
        end

        def boolean_true_token?(text)
          @coerce_opts
          text == 'true' || text == 'yes'
        end

        def boolean_false_token?(text)
          @coerce_opts
          text == 'false' || text == 'no'
        end

        def boolean_empty_token?(text)
          @coerce_opts
          text == ''
        end

        def regexp_missing_slash?(str, right_slash_position)
          @coerce_opts
          right_slash_position < str.size - 3
        end

        def regexp_body_and_options(str, right_slash_position)
          @coerce_opts
          body = str[1...right_slash_position]
          options = str[(right_slash_position + 1)..-1]
          [body, options]
        end

        def json_object_text?(val)
          @coerce_opts
          string_like?(val) && val.start_with?('{')
        end

        def json_array_text?(val)
          @coerce_opts
          string_like?(val) && val.start_with?('[')
        end

        def csv_mapping_text?(val)
          @coerce_opts
          string_like?(val) && !val.start_with?('{')
        end

        def csv_sequence_text?(val)
          @coerce_opts
          string_like?(val) && !val.start_with?('[')
        end

        def coerce_missing_value?(val)
          @coerce_name
          @coerce_opts
          val.nil?
        end

        def array_section_payload?(val)
          @base_indent
          val.is_a?(Array)
        end

        def hash_section_payload?(val)
          @base_indent
          val.is_a?(Hash)
        end

        def ensure_indent_step_configured
          if @base_indent.nil?
            raise ArgumentError, 'YAML section indent step is not configured'
          end
          @base_indent
        end

        def top_level_section_keys
          @base_indent
          ['label', 'source', 'filter', 'match', 'worker']
        end

        def included_section_key?(key)
          ensure_indent_step_configured
          case key
          when 'label', 'worker', 'source', 'filter', 'match'
            true
          else
            false
          end
        end

          ensure_indent_step_configured
          case key
          when 'label'
            build_label_section(body, indent: indent)
          when 'worker'
            build_worker_section(body, indent: indent)
          when 'source'
            build_source_section(body, indent: indent)
          when 'filter'
            build_filter_section(body, indent: indent)
          when 'match'
            build_match_section(body, indent: indent)
          end
        end

        def copy_section_config(config)
          ensure_indent_step_configured
          if config.respond_to?(:dup)
            config.dup
          else
            config
          end
        end

        def delete_config_key(config, key)

          if config.respond_to?(:delete)
            config.delete(key)
          end
        end

        def section_open_tag(name, arg)
          @render_indent
          if arg && !arg.to_s.empty?

module Fluent
  module Config
    module YamlParser
      SectionBuilder = Struct.new(:name, :body, :indent_size, :arg) do
        def to_s
          Loader.new.render_named_section(self)
        end

        def to_element
          Loader.new.elementize_named_section(self)

      class RootBuilder
        def initialize(system, conf)
          @system = system
          @conf = conf
        end

        attr_reader :system, :conf

        def to_element

        end

        def to_s
          Loader.new.render_root_builder(self)
        end
      end

      class SectionBodyBuilder
        Row = Struct.new(:key, :value, :indent) do
          def to_s
            "#{indent}#{key} #{value}"
          end
        end

        def initialize(indent, root: false)

          @bodies = []
          @root = root

        def add_section(section)
          @bodies << section
        end

        def to_element
          Loader.new.elementize_section_body(self)
        end

        def to_s
          Loader.new.render_section_body(self)
        end

The fix is complete. Summary of changes in `lib/fluent/config/yaml_parser/loader.rb`:

- **Glob detection**: The `!include` handler now checks whether the resolved path contains glob characters (`*`, `?`, `{`, `}`, `[`, `]`).
- **`load_glob`**: For glob patterns, each match is loaded (recursively, so nested/relative includes within matched files still resolve), and the entries are spliced into the enclosing sequence in sorted `Dir.glob` order. Non-glob paths keep the original behavior (including the `Errno::ENOENT` for missing files).
- **Flattening**: Include results that are arrays are flattened before embedding, so entries from single or multiple included files merge correctly into the enclosing `config` list.

Verified: `test_included_glob` (the failing FAIL_TO_PASS case) now passes, `test_included` and all YAML-related suites (`test_supervisor.rb`, `test_sd_file.rb`, `test_fluentd.rb`) pass, and the issue's exact scenario (absolute glob path, plus nested relative glob includes) works. The single remaining `test_include` failure in `test/test_config.rb` is pre-existing on the unmodified baseline and unrelated to the YAML loader.
